The read-only sampling script is still running against production packiyo connections. Its output is buffered, so I'll get the results when it exits, and I'll report them then.

For each connection it takes one 7-day window of orders at eight points from 2024-03 to 2026-10. For each window it counts packages where `tracking_number` is filled or null. Those counts are split by single- vs multi-package shipments, and the nulls are split again by whether the shipment has its own shipping tracking to fall back on. It also flags any package that's missing the `tracking_number` key entirely, which would break the direct index added in #6435 (`integrations/wms/packiyo/integration.py:982`).

I stopped the sampling run before it finished, so the check produced no results. It only read data from production and changed nothing there. The script is still at `.claude/tmp/packiyo_pkg_tracking_age.py` (gitignored) if you want to run it later.
